component.name: Interstellar Observatory
component.summary: Real-time relativistic spacetime GPU ray-tracing suite

description.p: Interstellar Observatory brings nine real-time relativistic GPU ray-tracing simulators powered by Rust, wgpu, and egui: Kerr Black Hole (Gargantua), Morris-Thorne Wormhole, Binary Black Holes, Alcubierre Warp Drive, Volumetric Supernova Remnant, Magnetar Pulsar, Relativistic Starflight, Gravitational Lensing Observatory, and Tidal Disruption Event.
Tidal Disruption Event engine, live GPU pass profiler overlay, and visual parity exporter.
